entities.name: Charles XII & the Great Northern War
entities.label: EventWindow
entities.summary: Charles XII's brilliant early victories at Narva (1700), the fateful invasion of Russia, the catastrophic defeat at Poltava (1709), exile in the Ottoman Empire, and his death at Fredriksten (1718) ending Swedish great-power status.
